create.title: New project session
create.intro: A project session binds one directory on disk to this conversation: the agent works out of that directory and can read and write files in it.
create.unselectedHint: Pick a directory on the desktop machine; you can change it later.
create.nameHint: Leave empty to use the folder name.
create.riskyHint: “{{path}}” is a system directory or may hold credentials. The agent runs as the desktop machine's OS user, so its permissions are not limited to this directory.
create.riskyConfirmHint: If that is what you want, tap “Create anyway” once more.
create.whitespaceHint: A segment of “{{path}}” starts or ends with a space; the desktop rejects such paths. Pick the directory again or rename it.

errors.edgeWhitespace: Path segments cannot start or end with a space
errors.notOwner: This account is not the installation owner, so it cannot reach the desktop file system

sheet.title: Working directory
sheet.projectHint: The agent works out of this directory and can read and write files in it.
sheet.temporaryHint: This is a temporary directory the desktop allocated automatically and manages itself. Temporary sessions cannot be rebound to a project directory — create a new project session if you need a fixed one.
sheet.changeBody:
New directory: {{path}}

Changing it restarts this conversation's agent; it takes effect on the next message.
sheet.changeRisky: Careful: this is a system directory or one that may hold credentials.
sheet.changed: Working directory changed; effective on the next message

files.title: Project files
files.readOnly: Read-only: the phone does not open, edit or download files.
files.emptyHint: Files the agent creates in this directory show up here.
files.missingHint: It has not been created yet, or it was deleted.
files.noWorkspaceTitle: This session has no working directory
files.noWorkspaceHint: Check the conversation's configuration on the desktop.
files.loadFailed: Could not read the project files

preview.readOnly: Read-only preview: the phone cannot edit, save or download — use the desktop for that.
preview.truncated: Too long to show in full — first {{chars}} characters only (file is {{size}}). Open it on the desktop for the rest.

refused.binaryHint: It does not look like text (an image, archive, binary…). Open it on the desktop.
refused.tooLargeHint: This file is {{size}}, over the {{limit}} phone preview limit. Open it on the desktop.
refused.emptyHint: There is nothing in this file right now.

failed.forbidden: The desktop refused to read this file: it is outside this conversation's working directory, or this account is not the installation owner.
failed.notFound: The file is gone — it was probably just moved or deleted. Pull to refresh.
failed.unreadable: This file is not UTF-8 text, so the phone cannot display it. Open it on the desktop.
failed.unknown: Could not read the file. Try again.
